title: 3sum
description: Find all unique triplets in the array 'nums' such that their sum is zero. The solution set must not contain duplicate triplets.

steps.note: Start threeSum function.
Initialize an empty list to store the results.
Check if the array has at least 3 elements. (6 >= 3) is true.
Sort the input array to efficiently use the two-pointer approach and handle duplicates.
Start the outer loop with 'i' for the first element of the triplet.
Check for duplicates of 'i'. Since i=0, there's no previous element to compare. (i > 0) is false.
Initialize the 'left' pointer to i + 1.
Initialize the 'right' pointer to the last element of the array.
Calculate the 'target' sum for the two pointers (left + right) as -nums[i]. (-(-4) = 4).
Start the inner two-pointer loop. Condition (left < right) (1 < 5) is true.
Calculate the current sum of elements at 'left' and 'right': nums[1] + nums[5] = -1 + 2 = 1.
The current sum (1) is less than the target (4). Increment 'left' to increase the sum.
Increment 'left' pointer.
Continue inner loop. Condition (left < right) (2 < 5) is true.
Calculate current sum: nums[2] + nums[5] = -1 + 2 = 1.
The current sum (1) is less than the target (4). Increment 'left' to increase the sum.
Increment 'left' pointer.
Continue inner loop. Condition (left < right) (3 < 5) is true.
Calculate current sum: nums[3] + nums[5] = 0 + 2 = 2.
The current sum (2) is less than the target (4). Increment 'left' to increase the sum.
Increment 'left' pointer.
Continue inner loop. Condition (left < right) (4 < 5) is true.
Calculate current sum: nums[4] + nums[5] = 1 + 2 = 3.
The current sum (3) is less than the target (4). Increment 'left' to increase the sum.
Increment 'left' pointer.
Inner loop condition (left < right) (5 < 5) is false. Inner loop ends.
Move to the next 'i' in the outer loop.
Check for duplicates of 'i'. (i > 0 && nums[i] === nums[i-1]) is (1 > 0 && nums[1](-1) === nums[0](-4)), which is false. Not a duplicate.
Initialize the 'left' pointer to i + 1.
Initialize the 'right' pointer to the last element of the array.
Calculate the 'target' sum: -nums[i] (-(-1) = 1).
Start inner two-pointer loop. Condition (left < right) (2 < 5) is true.
Calculate current sum: nums[2] + nums[5] = -1 + 2 = 1.
The current sum (1) equals the target (1). A triplet is found!
Add the triplet [nums[i], nums[left], nums[right]] ([-1, -1, 2]) to results.
Skip duplicate elements for the 'left' pointer. (left < right && nums[left] === nums[left+1]) is (2 < 5 && nums[2](-1) === nums[3](0)), which is false. No skip.
Skip duplicate elements for the 'right' pointer. (left < right && nums[right] === nums[right-1]) is (2 < 5 && nums[5](2) === nums[4](1)), which is false. No skip.
Increment 'left' pointer to find the next distinct pair.
Decrement 'right' pointer to find the next distinct pair.
Continue inner loop. Condition (left < right) (3 < 4) is true.
Calculate current sum: nums[3] + nums[4] = 0 + 1 = 1.
The current sum (1) equals the target (1). Another triplet is found!
Add the triplet [nums[i], nums[left], nums[right]] ([-1, 0, 1]) to results.
Skip duplicate elements for the 'left' pointer. (left < right && nums[left] === nums[left+1]) is (3 < 4 && nums[3](0) === nums[4](1)), which is false. No skip.
Skip duplicate elements for the 'right' pointer. (left < right && nums[right] === nums[right-1]) is (3 < 4 && nums[4](1) === nums[3](0)), which is false. No skip.
Increment 'left' pointer.
Decrement 'right' pointer.
Inner loop condition (left < right) (4 < 3) is false. Inner loop ends.
Move to the next 'i' in the outer loop.
Check for duplicates of 'i'. (i > 0 && nums[i] === nums[i-1]) is (2 > 0 && nums[2](-1) === nums[1](-1)), which is true. Duplicate found.
Skip this duplicate 'i' using 'continue'.
Move to the next 'i' in the outer loop.
Check for duplicates of 'i'. (i > 0 && nums[i] === nums[i-1]) is (3 > 0 && nums[3](0) === nums[2](-1)), which is false. Not a duplicate.
Initialize the 'left' pointer to i + 1.
Initialize the 'right' pointer to the last element of the array.
Calculate the 'target' sum: -nums[i] (-(0) = 0).
Start inner two-pointer loop. Condition (left < right) (4 < 5) is true.
Calculate current sum: nums[4] + nums[5] = 1 + 2 = 3.
The current sum (3) is greater than the target (0). Decrement 'right' to decrease the sum.
Decrement 'right' pointer.
Inner loop condition (left < right) (4 < 4) is false. Inner loop ends.
Outer loop condition (i < nums.length - 2) is (3 < 6 - 2 = 4), which is true. Increment i to 4.
Outer loop condition (i < nums.length - 2) is (4 < 6 - 2 = 4), which is false. Outer loop ends.
All elements have been processed. Return the collected unique triplets.
